name: Pokoy nam tolko snitsya
source:
"An endless number of cycles...
I am so sick of all this...
They... they don't change...
Peace...
Give me peace at last!
And...freedom."

A short story about two people who are very similar to each other.
Once, he was alone...
Now there are countless numbers of them...
This is the story of a single, specific "Pioneer," spiced up with lots of sci-fi.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1717853577]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“无数次的循环……
我厌倦了这一切……
他们……他们没有改变……
和平…
最后给我平安吧！
还有……自由。”

一个关于两个非常相似的人的短篇故事。
曾经，他孤身一人……
现在已经有无数的人了……
这是一个单一的、特定的“先锋”的故事，充满了很多科幻色彩。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1717853577]Steam[/url]]
